summary_zh: 路透 2 月 18 日 - 印度数据中心公司 Yotta Data Services 周三表示，将在一个项目中使用 Nvidia 最新的 Blackwell Ultra 芯片建造亚洲最大的人工智能计算中心之一

title: Tesla avoids suspension by California regulator after corrective marketing changes
title_zh: 特斯拉在纠正营销变化后避免了加州监管机构的停牌
summary: Feb 17 (Reuters) - Tesla will avoid a 30-day suspension of its dealer and manufacturer licenses in California after the U.S. electric vehicle maker stopped using the term "autopilot" in marketing of
summary_zh: 2 月 17 日（路透社）——在美国电动汽车制造商停止在营销中使用“自动驾驶”一词后，特斯拉将避免其在加利福尼亚州的经销商和制造商许可证被暂停 30 天。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures steady with AI disruption in focus, Fed minutes ahead
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货稳定，人工智能颠覆成为焦点，美联储会议纪要即将到来
summary: Wall Street is entering the final stretch of this batch of earnings as AI dominates stock conversations.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能主导股票市场，华尔街正进入这批财报的最后阶段。

title: Equities close with slight gains as tech shares recover
title_zh: 随着科技股复苏，股市小幅上涨
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes eked out slight gains on Tuesday, with the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all nudging up marginally.Technology and other AI-related shares rebounded from lows earlier in the session, explains Eric Lynch, managing director at Suncoast Equity Managemen...
summary_zh: 故事：周二，华尔街主要股指小幅上涨，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数均小幅上涨。 Suncoast Equity Management 董事总经理埃里克·林奇 (Eric Lynch) 解释说，科技股和其他人工智能相关股票从盘中早些时候的低点反弹。

title: Nvidia and Meta expand GPU team up with millions of additional AI chips
title_zh: Nvidia 和 Meta 扩大 GPU 团队，新增数百万个 AI 芯片
summary: Nvidia and Meta are expanding their chip deal to include millions of more AI processors.
summary_zh: Nvidia 和 Meta 正在扩大他们的芯片交易，以涵盖数百万个人工智能处理器。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq end higher in volatile trading day as Apple jumps
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数在波动交易日收高，苹果公司股价上涨

title: What mega-cap tech's massive capex means for small & mid caps

summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are beginning to find their footing ahead of Tuesday's market close as AI drives volatility across the tech sector.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能推动整个科技行业的波动，美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在周二收盘前开始站稳脚跟。

title: Software: Is the 'SaaS-pocalypse' overplayed amid tech's AI scare?

summary_zh: 随着人工智能的担忧继续扰乱市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）和科技领域，华尔街将这些担忧称为“SaaS 末日”。公民商业银行副主席马克·莱曼 (Mark Lehmann) 分享了他对科技生态这一过渡阶段的看法……
